summary: Two-project integration brief: Agent Loop proposes autonomous work (README.md:53-54), while Tool Gate evaluates proposed tool invocations and emits allow, deny, or review_required receipts without executing tools (README.md:5-13,53-56). Their shared safety boundary is the transition from agent intent to runtime execution: every proposal should become an InvocationEnvelope plus ToolMetadata and receive a deterministic Tool Gate decision before side effects (README.md:17-20,39-48). Recommendation: integrate Agent Loop’s execution path so it cannot invoke the runtime until Tool Gate returns allow, routes review_required to an operator, and records all receipts. Tool Gate risk: it is not a sandbox and depends on external authentication, authorization, sandboxing, and runtime enforcement (README.md:156-158). Agent Loop risk: an execution adapter could bypass the gate and run proposals directly (README.md:31-33). The declared clean-tree check succeeded; no files were modified.
